demoPolicy: Each demo must use the real application and its real backend where required, isolated from production/customer data. Synthetic fixtures are allowed. A project remains verification-pending until the complete flow is tested from the public entry point.

projects.name: FrameFlux
projects.oneLiner: Turn large media work into durable, observable jobs.
projects.overview: An asynchronous media-processing platform with resumable uploads, strict file validation, durable job state, queued workers, and FFmpeg transformations.
features: Resumable chunked uploads with pause, resume, retry, and cancellation
Extension, MIME/category, size, and binary-signature validation
Background probe and transform jobs using Redis and ARQ
Progress and job lifecycle visibility
Media transforms including probe, transcode, trim, split, merge, watermark, overlays, and freeze frames
projects.demoPlan: Provide a small set of safe synthetic media samples and a real isolated worker. Let recruiters upload within strict limits, follow a real job, inspect progress, and exercise retry/cancel paths. Clean up files and jobs automatically.

projects.name: Telemetry
projects.oneLiner: Follow signals from ingestion to alert and incident.
projects.overview: A realtime observability workspace that unifies synthetic telemetry and real host-agent events through one processing pipeline, then detects anomalies, evaluates alert rules, correlates incidents, persists state, and streams updates.
features: Synthetic generator and real host-agent ingestion
Realtime metric charts and historical analytics
Anomaly detection and configurable sustained-duration alert rules
Alert lifecycle, cooldowns, deduplication, and incident correlation
SLO/SLI and error-budget views
Authenticated WebSocket updates, host administration, webhooks, and runtime metrics
projects.demoPlan: Use an isolated demo workspace with synthetic telemetry only. Enable safe simulation controls, alert acknowledgement, incident workflows, and WebSocket streaming. Do not expose real host enrollment or unrestricted admin operations.

projects.name: Sayphora
projects.oneLiner: A beauty storefront backed by real commerce workflows.
projects.overview: A full-stack beauty and skincare commerce platform. Catalogue, cart pricing, orders, inventory, reviews, wishlists, loyalty, AI beauty tools, and staff operations are backed by an Express API and PostgreSQL.
features: Product discovery, filters, sorting, details, and comparison
Accounts, addresses, wishlists, cart, promotions, and checkout
Order tracking and cancellation
Shade matching, skincare routines, ingredient diagnostics, and virtual try-on
Loyalty rewards, inventory, fulfilment, reviews, and admin analytics
PWA installation and offline catalogue behavior
projects.demoPlan: Seed a dedicated demo catalogue, inventory, promo codes, reviews, and demo customer. Disable real payment settlement and use a clearly labelled test checkout. Keep admin access separate from recruiter sessions.

projects.name: Focus Journal
projects.oneLiner: Turn daily reflection and focus sessions into visible patterns.
projects.overview: A private journaling and focus application for structured daily check-ins, journal entries, focus sessions, saved history, and optional AI-assisted insights.
features: Account registration, sign-in, and OAuth code exchange
Daily check-ins with mood and tags
Private journal CRUD and history search
Focus sessions with pause, resume, completion, and abandonment
Weekly, monthly, streak, and tag summaries
Privacy settings and optional AI insights with explicit consent
architecture: JWT and single-use OAuth exchange codes
projects.demoPlan: Create an isolated synthetic journal account with fictional entries and focus history. Clearly mark all records as demo data. Disable personal OAuth and ensure the recruiter cannot access another demo user's entries.

projects.name: Nexora
projects.oneLiner: Track competitor offerings, collect prices, and detect changes.
projects.overview: A multi-tenant competitive price-intelligence workspace for tracked offerings, competitor catalogs, source discovery, product matching, collection jobs, price observations, snapshots, and alerts.
features: Organizations with owner, analyst, and viewer roles
Tracked offerings, competitors, source URLs, and matches
Website discovery and optional assisted discovery
HTTP and browser-rendered price collection
Collection job visibility and historical price observations
Competitive alerts and monitoring workflows
projects.demoPlan: Use fictional products and deterministic sample retailer pages or controlled fixtures. Do not issue arbitrary outbound fetches from a public demo. Expose collection runs only against allowlisted fixtures, then show stored observations and alerts.

projects.name: Flagship
projects.oneLiner: Change application behavior with typed flags and deterministic rollouts.
projects.overview: A feature-flag management platform with organizations, projects, environments, typed flags, targeting rules, reusable segments, server-side evaluation, SDK credentials, and audit history.
features: Account and organization membership
Project and environment management
Typed flags with environment-specific configuration
Conditional targeting and reusable audience segments
Deterministic percentage rollout and single/batch evaluation
SDK key creation and rotation plus audit history
projects.demoPlan: Provision a seeded demo organization and project with sample environments and flags. Let recruiters change targeting and rollout, then evaluate known test contexts. Keep SDK secrets and destructive organization management unavailable.

projects.name: Fieldline CRM
projects.oneLiner: Make customer relationships and follow-through operational.
projects.overview: A small-business CRM with tenant-scoped customers, companies, opportunities, activities, data imports, saved views, relationship intelligence, and workflow automation.
features: Company and contact records with organization scoping
Sales pipeline and opportunity stage history
Tasks, activities, and follow-up workflows
CSV preview, validation, dry run, and import
Saved views, duplicate detection, and controlled merges
Relationship health, graph, attention queue, automation, and audit logs
architecture: Next.js frontend and same-origin API rewrite
PostgreSQL row-level security and audit events
projects.demoPlan: Seed one fictional organization with connected companies, contacts, opportunities, activities, and saved views. Demonstrate tenant separation with two isolated demo tenants and no real contact data.

projects.name: Orbit Campaigns
projects.oneLiner: Author campaigns and follow delivery through durable background work.
projects.overview: A campaign-management system covering audiences, contacts, campaign authoring, scheduling, reusable templates, delivery tracking, open/click events, and reporting.
features: Owner-scoped audiences and contacts
Campaign authoring, editing, scheduling, and execution
Reusable campaign templates
Durable delivery records and retry-aware failed delivery handling
Background delivery worker and subscription rechecks
Open/click tracking and campaign reports
projects.demoPlan: Use fictional contacts with all outbound mail redirected to a capture mailbox or preview-only transport. Never send unsolicited email. Show queued, delivered-to-capture, skipped, failed, and retry states distinctly.

projects.name: Product Analytics
projects.oneLiner: Follow product events into trends, funnels, retention, and cohorts.
projects.overview: A self-hosted product analytics platform with event ingestion, identity resolution, PostgreSQL analytics, reports, dashboards, cohorts, alerts, exports, and a JavaScript SDK.
features: Single and batch event ingestion with project API keys
Trends, funnels, retention, sessions, and user journeys
People profiles, event properties, and identity resolution
Behavioral cohort definitions and membership preview
Saved reports, dashboards, and alerts
Data exports, background jobs, and SDK distribution
architecture: Redis rate limiting and query cache
Background export, alert, cohort, retention, and cleanup workers
projects.demoPlan: Provide a generated synthetic event dataset and a dedicated demo project API key with strict quotas. Let recruiters run trends/funnel/retention queries and build cohorts without ingesting any visitor or real customer data.

projects.name: Gemini Chat Platform
projects.oneLiner: Explore queued OpenAI-powered chat and persisted conversations.
projects.overview: A saved-conversation chat product with OTP-assisted access, PostgreSQL chat history, an asynchronous Redis worker and Stripe subscription flow. Important provider note: despite the Gemini branding, the inspected backend currently calls OpenAI GPT-3.5-turbo; the production Render API is documented as suspended and the local walkthrough did not generate an assistant answer without a provider key.
features: OTP sign-in and password recovery flows
Searchable chatroom history and reloadable conversations
Redis-backed asynchronous message queue and worker
Backend-enforced message limits
Account settings and plan status
Stripe sandbox checkout redirect
architecture: Redis queue, polling, and rate limits
OpenAI chat completion provider in the documented implementation
projects.demoPlan: Provide a guest demo session with pre-seeded fictional chat history and rate-limited live prompt usage only if a funded provider key is configured. Otherwise expose safe recorded provider responses and clearly label them as replay, never as live model output. Payments remain test-only.

projects.name: AgencyOS
projects.oneLiner: Connect the commercial and delivery work of an agency.
projects.overview: A multi-tenant agency operations workspace for clients, deals, proposals, projects, tasks, time tracking, invoicing, team access, reporting and a client portal. Its in-product assistant is PostgreSQL full-text search plus report shortcuts, not an LLM.
features: Clients, contacts, deals, and validated deal-stage history
Proposal drafting, state transitions, and project creation on acceptance
Project milestones, task boards, members, files, and discussions
Running timers, manual time entries, approvals, and timesheets
Invoice issuing, PDF generation, manual payment recording, and reports
Client portal, MFA, webhooks, notifications, audit and transactional outbox
Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL full-text search and keyword report assistant (not LLM)
architecture: PostgreSQL-backed background jobs and transactional outbox
projects.demoPlan: Create a unique short-lived organisation and synthetic owner/client/team accounts per visitor. Run the real connected deal → proposal acceptance → project → time approval → invoice/PDF/manual-payment workflow against PostgreSQL with RLS enabled. Route all invite/reset/invoice email to a private no-relay capture sink; use only a fixed safe webhook receiver; keep payments as clearly fictional manual records; store uploads in per-demo persistent storage; expire and purge the entire demo tenant. A complete authenticated browser journey and two-tenant isolation test are required before the demo is marked ready.

projects.name: CleanFlow
projects.oneLiner: Move a cleaning job from inquiry through service and invoice.
projects.overview: A commercial cleaning operations platform connecting customer intake and quote management with contracts, recurring schedules, field jobs, invoicing, payments, and customer history.
features: Public quote requests and customer/property records
Quote pricing and quote lifecycle
Contracts and recurring schedules
Employee assignment, job check-in/out, checklists, notes, and photo uploads
Invoices, PDFs, exports, and idempotent payment recording
Reporting, audit, notifications, and signed webhook delivery
projects.demoPlan: Use synthetic customers, properties, contracts, and jobs in a disposable database. Do not run the repository's seed script until its destructive behavior is inspected; no outbound SMS, email, or webhooks in recruiter mode.

projects.name: FlowDesk
projects.oneLiner: Manage client work from task board to billable time.
projects.overview: A multi-tenant workspace for client/project management, Kanban tasks, time tracking, invoicing, team roles, notifications, API keys and file attachments. It has real PostgreSQL-backed workflows and tenant-aware authorization; invoice payment is a manual status transition, not payment processing.
features: Workspace registration, membership roles, invitations and tenant switching
Tenant-scoped clients, projects, tasks, Kanban movement and comments
Server-side running timers and manual time entries
Invoices generated from billable time and explicit state transitions
Activity feed, dashboard metrics, global search and notifications
Tenant-specific attachments, hashed API keys and webhook delivery history
projects.demoPlan: Create a unique short-lived user and tenant for each recruiter and seed synthetic clients, projects, tasks and time entries. Use the real PostgreSQL-backed workflows, invoice generation and role permissions. Keep outbound email in a private capture sink, disable arbitrary webhook URLs (the current sender has no SSRF defenses), use only a fixed owned receiver if needed, and keep invoice Paid as a demo status rather than a transfer. Store small synthetic attachments in a persistent per-tenant directory with streaming upload caps and content validation; revoke tokens/API keys and clean the tenant on expiry. Full deployed browser verification is still required.

projects.name: SupportAI
projects.oneLiner: Trace a support answer back to retrieved knowledge.
projects.overview: A multi-tenant support-agent workspace with a document knowledge base, background ingestion, hybrid pgvector/full-text retrieval, local model generation, cited conversations, low-confidence handoff and ticket management. The default AI runtime is local Ollama llama3.1:8b, not a hosted API.
features: Organization-scoped customers, users, memberships and role permissions
Versioned PDF, text, Markdown and HTML knowledge documents
Asynchronous extraction, structure-aware chunking and local embeddings
Hybrid pgvector/full-text retrieval, reciprocal-rank fusion and optional local cross-encoder reranking
Ollama-powered answers with persisted source citations and low-confidence warnings
Conversation history, escalation, ticket assignment, status lifecycle and internal notes
architecture: Local Ollama model runtime and embedding/reranking models
projects.demoPlan: Give each recruiter a short-lived isolated organization with synthetic customers, documents, conversations and tickets. Run the actual PostgreSQL/pgvector + Procrastinate ingestion worker + local Ollama RAG stack and show answer citations, low-confidence/human handoff, and ticket escalation. This requires a persistent server with the roughly 4.9 GB model plus embedding/reranker caches; a cold model may take minutes. Do not expose arbitrary URL ingestion until the documented DNS-rebinding gap is fixed; apply streaming upload limits, handle password-reset tokens without logging, and clean the temporary tenant and file directory on expiry. No public runtime was verified, so deployment remains pending.

projects.name: Service Agreement Manager
projects.oneLiner: Connect customer agreements to recurring field work and invoice payment.
projects.overview: A company-scoped HVAC/plumbing service-business system for customers, service locations, equipment, versioned agreements, maintenance schedules, technician work orders, invoices and customer portals. Customer acceptance is recorded through a versioned, single-use portal token; it is not a certified e-signature service. Stripe PaymentIntents are implemented but disabled by default.
features: Company/branch roles, customers, service locations, equipment and service catalogue
Versioned agreement drafts, proposal lifecycle, customer portal acceptance and renewal actions
Maintenance schedules, duplicate-safe work-order generation and technician operations
Invoices, recurring billing, payments, refunds, credits, PDFs and exports
Separate customer, agreement and invoice portals with scoped access
Durable email/SMS/webhook outboxes, retries, attachments and reporting
Optional Stripe PaymentIntent integration with server-calculated amounts, verification and idempotent recording
architecture: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite frontend with Stripe Elements
PostgreSQL 16 + Alembic and Redis-backed production rate limits
Separate maintenance, billing, webhook and notification workers; optional SMS worker
HttpOnly cookie sessions, refresh rotation, CSRF/origin checks and company/branch role scope
Persistent local or S3-compatible attachment storage
projects.demoPlan: Provision one short-lived synthetic company per visitor, including owner/manager/technician/billing and a separate customer-portal identity. Run the real agreement-version → portal acceptance → recurring maintenance → work order → invoice/PDF flow on the deployed API and workers. Route all email to a private no-relay capture inbox, keep SMS disabled, and use one fixed webhook capture receiver. Online card payment is allowed only with backend-enforced Stripe test keys; otherwise show manual sample payment records and keep card controls disabled. Use isolated persistent storage and purge every company-scoped record, token, outbox row and attachment on expiry.

projects.name: AutoFix
projects.oneLiner: Run a repair journey from vehicle check-in to invoice.
projects.overview: An automotive workshop management platform for customers, vehicles, appointments, inspections, repair orders, inventory, estimates, invoices, and customer self-service.
features: Customer and vehicle records with mileage
Appointment scheduling and conflict checks
Digital inspections and photo records
Repair orders, technician tasks, labor, and quality control
Parts inventory, suppliers, and purchase orders
Estimates, customer line-item approval, invoices, payments, and portal
architecture: Role-based access and database-backed auth limits
projects.demoPlan: Seed fictional vehicles, appointments, inspection results, repair orders, parts, and estimates. Keep payment provider calls disabled and run appointment/repair state changes only against demo tenant data.

projects.name: LedgerPulse
projects.oneLiner: Manage invoices and expenses with organization-aware access.
projects.overview: An invoice and expense-management product using Firebase Authentication for identity, a Flask API for business workflows, and PostgreSQL as the authoritative data store.
features: Firebase identity and organization discovery
Organization membership and role-aware access
Customers, vendors, and invoice management
Payment and expense records
Recurring invoices and scheduled jobs
Public contact form and admin operational overview
projects.demoPlan: Inspect the existing browser-local demo mode and make it visibly separate from API mode. Prefer a demo Firebase identity and isolated seeded organization. No real invoices, balances, payments, or SMTP deliveries.
